why_not: I already paid a developer and a portal and got almost nothing back, so Rs 60,000 plus Rs 5,000 every month to a small remote studio I have never met, with only one past client, is not something I will risk. My enquiries are manageable by hand right now.

The money is not the issue for a firm our size, but my quoting runs through IndiaMART and my own phone and it works. I am not putting my price list and buyer enquiries on a system run by a small remote studio with one client to show.

Most of my orders come from regular buyers who just call me, and I quote them from memory in two minutes. IndiaMART already gives me a catalogue and enquiries, so paying Rs 60,000 plus Rs 5,000 every month for another website and a quote desk doesn't solve a problem I actually have.

My buyers come from IndiaMART, which I already pay for, and a website alone will not bring me buyers. I am not putting Rs 60,000 plus Rs 5,000 every month into a site nobody visits when I can quote from my phone in five minutes.

My staff already answer enquiries on WhatsApp and IndiaMART the same day, and my rates change with raw material every week, so I don't see why I should pay Rs 60,000 plus Rs 5,000 every month for a system to draft what my sales boy types in two minutes.

IndiaMART already gives me a catalogue and the enquiries, and I reply from my phone fine. The money is not the problem for a firm my size, but I don't see why I should pay a small remote studio to fix something that is working for me.
why_yes: Last month I lost an order only because the other supplier quoted first, and Rs 45,000 plus Rs 5,000 a month is small money for a firm our size if it gets quotes out in minutes. I would take the opening offer, but only after they show me a quote drafted from our real price list, and I would still have to convince my father.

I'd take the opening offer, but only after I see a live demo on our own price list.
